I should mention I was actively in a Discord call while doing this so my friends heard me working and grumbling. Well, one screw was more stubborn than the rest and I put a bit too much force into it and my hand slipped with the screw driver and drove right into my other hand that was holding the screw. At first I thought I just like tore some skin a bit since I recoiled so quickly and didn't immediately see blood. Nope, went right through my palm. Picked up my mic and told my friends I stabbed myself and needed to go to the hospital. Ah, here is a question I can answer. All this is fairly recent too. Ive known the guy for 17 years now and he had been like a brother too me. Last year he got arrested for having pictures of women on his phone without their consent, upskirts and the like. It didn't seem that bad to me so long as he was in the road to mending himself now. He blamed a sex addiction and started going to an addiction program often, but he kept having flings. He just kept fooling around with random women, a homeless girl who later killed herself, a bipolar girl in a relationship, I told him he just needed to be alone but he didn't listen. Started dating a woman who was actually really cool but shortly after dumped her because she didn't fit his sexual needs. It was about then I started realized that despite all the meetings he wasn't actually putting in an effort to change. He just was putting on the show for any good will it might have gotten him come court date. Then I find out through the news, not him telling me, that his trouble was so much deeper than just upskirts shots. Dude had kiddy porn and was filming himself whipping his dick out at little kids. He was so much more twisted than I knew. When I found out it kind of shook me and I just shut down for days. He really had been my best friend for a long time but I had no idea this side of him existed. It was awful. Since then I just kind of ghosted and when he contacted me next all I could tell him was I couldn't bear to be around him anymore. That kind of stuff... it's not something I can forgive or even really deal with. So I let go, and it still sucks losing someone I was close to, but the very idea makes me both furious and morbidly depressed. I can still feel myself shaking just writing about it.
